1.

The present application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 29.02.2022 and proceedings of Criminal Case No. 5575 of 2020 (State vs. Sunil Yadav) arising out of Case Crime No. 379 of 2019 under Sections 498A, 323, 504 & 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. F.T.C. (Mahila), Azamgarh on the basis of compromise.
